```{r install packages}
BiocManager::install("edgeR")a
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Load Required Libraries

```{r load-libraries}
library(edgeR)
library(ggplot2)
library(Biostrings)  # For working with FASTA files
```

## Load Count Matrix

```{r load-data}
## Load Count Matrix

# Load the count matrix
data <- read.table("/Users/oliver/Desktop/featureCounts_fastpProcessed_17_samples_UTMhap1_counts_fraction_brakerGTF_inc2023_dataset_cleaned_only2023_samples.txt", 
                   header = TRUE, row.names = 1, sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE, comment.char = "#")

# Remove specific columns (e.g., columns 2, 3, 4, and 5)
data <- data[, -c(1:5)]

# Ensure counts are numeric
counts <- as.matrix(data)

# Clean column names to extract sample IDs
colnames(counts) <- gsub("\\./|_Aligned\\.sortedByCoord\\.out\\.bam", "", colnames(counts))

# Dynamically assign groups based on sample prefixes
group_labels <- ifelse(grepl("^N", colnames(counts)), "None",
                ifelse(grepl("^L", colnames(counts)), "Low",
                ifelse(grepl("^H", colnames(counts)), "High", NA)))

# Subset counts and groups to include only "None" and "High"
valid_groups <- group_labels %in% c("None", "High")
counts <- counts[, valid_groups, drop = FALSE]
groups <- factor(group_labels[valid_groups])
```

## Create DGEList Object

```{r dge-object}
# Create DGEList object
dge <- DGEList(counts = counts, group = groups)

# Filter out lowly expressed genes
keep <- filterByExpr(dge)
dge <- dge[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]

# Normalize library sizes
dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)
```

## Estimate Dispersion

```{r estimate-dispersion}
# Estimate dispersion
dge <- estimateDisp(dge)
```

## Perform Differential Expression Analysis

```{r differential-expression}
# Perform exact test
dge_results <- exactTest(dge, pair = c("None", "High"))

dge_table <- topTags(dge_results, n = Inf)$table
significant_genes <- dge_table[dge_table$FDR < 0.001 & abs(dge_table$logFC) > 1, ]
```

## Plot Results

```{r plot-volcano}
# Volcano plot
volcano_data <- data.frame(
  logFC = dge_table$logFC,
  negLogFDR = -log10(dge_table$FDR),
  Significant = dge_table$FDR < 0.05
)

ggplot(volcano_data, aes(x = logFC, y = negLogFDR, color = Significant)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("grey", "red")) +
  labs(title = "Volcano Plot", x = "Log2 Fold Change", y = "-Log10(FDR)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Save Results

```{r save-results}
# Save significant genes to file
write.table(significant_genes, "/Users/oliver/Desktop/RNASeq_2025/R_edgeR_RNASeq/significant_genes_none_vs_high_fastpProcessed_stringent.txt", 
            sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = TRUE)
```

## Extract Significant Gene Sequences

```{r extract-sequences}
# Load significant gene IDs
sig_genes <- rownames(significant_genes)

# Read the fasta file
fasta_file <- "/Users/oliver/Desktop/RNASeq_2025/UTMhap1_stringtieMerged17GTFs_transcripts_updatedHeaders_geneIDs.fasta"  # Path to your fasta file that has MSTRG ID's as headers and then the corresponding transcript sequence
fasta <- readDNAStringSet(fasta_file)

# Filter fasta sequences to match significant genes
filtered_fasta <- fasta[names(fasta) %in% sig_genes]

# Save the filtered fasta to a specific location
output_fasta <- "/Users/oliver/Desktop/RNASeq_2025/R_edgeR_RNASeq/filtered_SigDE_sequences_none_vs_high_stringent.fasta"  # Replace with your desired path
writeXStringSet(filtered_fasta, filepath = output_fasta)

cat("Filtered sequences saved to:", output_fasta, "\n")
```

```{r write-headers}
# Write filtered fasta headers to a text file
headers_file <- "/Users/oliver/Desktop/RNASeq_2025/R_edgeR_RNASeq/filtered_fasta_headers_none_vs_high_stringent.txt"
writeLines(names(filtered_fasta), headers_file)
cat("Filtered fasta headers saved to:", headers_file, "\n")
```

## Verify Headers Match Significant Genes

```{r verify-headers}
# Load filtered fasta headers
fasta_headers <- readLines("/Users/oliver/Desktop/RNASeq_2025/R_edgeR_RNASeq/filtered_fasta_headers_none_vs_high_stringent.txt")

# Load significant genes
significant_genes_list <- rownames(significant_genes)

# Check for mismatches
mismatches <- setdiff(fasta_headers, significant_genes_list)

if (length(mismatches) == 0) {
  cat("All filtered fasta headers match significant genes.\n")
} else {
  cat("The following headers are mismatched or missing:\n")
  print(mismatches)
}
```
